item.title: Could Warriors be big players in Giannis trade sweepstakes?
item.description: The Warriors' future draft picks could help them get into the conversation.

item.title: DHS confirms Super Bowl security role amid fears of ICE enforcement — but details remain unclear
item.description: DHS has traditionally had a presence at the Super Bowl in years past.

item.title: As Tesla ​reports smallest profit since pandemic, company plans to shift Fremont factory to production of Optimus robots
item.description: CEO Elon Musk says the company will close down production of two older car models, S and X, and convert the Fremont factory to produce its Optimus robots instead.

item.title: Hundreds of students across Bay Area walk out of school to protest ICE
item.description: "What’s happening with ICE right now is not right at all," one student said.

item.title: Another Bay Area county creates ‘ICE-free zones’ after Minneapolis killings
item.description: In her introduction of the ordinances, Supervisor Nikki Fortunato Bas drew a direct tie between the ordinances and the violence in Minneapolis

item.title: Four-bedroom home in Danville sells for $1.6 million
item.description: The spacious unit in the first block of Haskins Ranch Circle in Danville was sold on Dec. 16, 2025 for $1,635,000 which represents a price per square foot of $815.

item.title: Discovery Bay man blazed trail for others with pioneering back surgery
item.description: He became German hospital's first American patient to receive artificial disc replacement.

item.title: Coastal flood advisory for North Bay Interior Valleys and San Francisco Bay Shoreline from Thursday to Sunday
item.description: North Bay Interior Valleys and San Francisco Bay Shoreline are included in a coastal flood advisory released by the National Weather Service on Wednesday at 8:07 p.m. The advisory is valid from Thursday 6 a.m. until Sunday Feb. 1, at noon.

item.title: Coastal flood advisory in place for Bay Area Shorelines from Thursday to Sunday
item.description: Northern Monterey Bay and Southern Monterey Bay and Big Sur Coast as well as San Francisco County are included in a coastal flood advisory issued by the National Weather Service on Wednesday at 8:07 p.m. The advisory is valid from Thursday 6 a.m. until Sunday Feb. 1, at noon.

item.title: Curry helps Golden State bury Utah 140-124 behind a flurry of 3-pointers
item.description: Golden State made 23 3-pointers and never trailed over the final three quarters while racking up a season-high 140 points in Utah.
